mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document sent by the bank to the entity or customer notifying it of the receipts or credits made to the entity's or customer's bank account."
A credit advice is a document sent by the bank to the entity or customer notifying it of the receipts or credits made to the entity's or customer's bank account.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered superior to periodic inventory system in many aspects such as frequency of updates of inventory value and cost of sales."
Perpetual inventory is considered superior to periodic inventory system in many aspects such as frequency of updates of inventory value and cost of sales.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a chronological record of the transactions of a business entity."
A journal is a chronological record of the transactions of a business entity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document sent by the bank to the entity or customer notifying it of the charges or debits made to the entity's or customer's bank account."
A debit advice is a document sent by the bank to the entity or customer notifying it of the charges or debits made to the entity's or customer's bank account.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the information will permit different independent and knowledgeable people to reach consensus to a large extent that a particular estimate or value faithfully represents economic reality."

Verifiability means that the information will permit different independent and knowledgeable people to reach consensus to a large extent that a particular estimate or value faithfully represents economic reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an information system that functions within an input-output system."
Accounting is an information system that functions within an input-output system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to summarise all the individual personal accounts of the trade debtors and trade creditors."
Control accounts are used to summarise all the individual personal accounts of the trade debtors and trade creditors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a non-current asset that is a subject of depreciation and whose value likely diminishes with usage or over time."
Depreciable asset is a non-current asset that is a subject of depreciation and whose value likely diminishes with usage or over time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those debts that are perpetual and have no liquidation or repayment date."
Irredeemable debts are those debts that are perpetual and have no liquidation or repayment date.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that information should be made available early to the users of the information for the purpose of decision-making."
Timeliness means that information should be made available early to the users of the information for the purpose of decision-making.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a cost-allocation process in accounting and not necessarily the technical conception that it is the wear and tear arising from the use of a non-current asset."
Depreciation is a cost-allocation process in accounting and not necessarily the technical conception that it is the wear and tear arising from the use of a non-current asset.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that have a repayment (or redemption) period, which may be 10, 20 or other years, depending on the agreed loan tenure."
Redeemable debts are those that have a repayment (or redemption) period, which may be 10, 20 or other years, depending on the agreed loan tenure.
